tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should have Supply of 50 persons per year to the Govt/Semi Govt. Preference will be given to bidder with experience in forest department.
Should be registered in Labour department, EPF, ESI, IT, GST, ISO issued by the Competent authority.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer Supply of labourers to Govt/Semi Govt at least 100 persons per year a) Achieved in at least three financial years a minimum financial turnover usually double the work estimate cost.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Each Tenderer should further demonstrate: (a) Liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities of not less than 30% of the ECV.
Contractors should be registered as Forest Contractor in any of the Forest Division Office for the financial year 2026-27.

The outsource Agency should upload the Notarized affidavit in respect of payment made as wage component ESI, PF and other taxes on or before 5th of every month, All extract in support of all the payment details should be uploaded. Any discrepancy in payment of wages PF, ESI and other taxes or no uploading of document by the outsource agency shall be treated seriously and such agency shall stands rejected.
Notarized affidavit saying that the bidder is not black listed by any of the Government offices.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Certificate from Nationalized banks for meeting the fund requirement Credit Lines/Letter of Credit in favour of Deputy Conservator of Forests, Cauvery Wildlife Division, Kollegal.
